# Ossila

> Ossila provides precision laboratory coating equipment and accessories for thin-film deposition across multiple techniques and scales.

Ossila specializes in manufacturing affordable, compact coating systems including spin coaters, slot die coaters, dip coaters, and film applicators. The company serves research and industrial labs globally with customizable equipment and comprehensive accessory ecosystems.

## Key Topics

- Spin Coater
- Slot Die Coater
- Thin-Film Coating
- Syringe Pump
- Dip Coater
- Film Applicator
- Large-Area Coating
- Coating Equipment
- Laboratory Equipment
- Substrate Holder
- Air Knife
- Doctor Blade Coater
- Bar Coater
- Vacuum Pump
- Coating Accessories

## Spin Coating Systems

- [Spin Coaters](https://www.ossila.com/products/spin-coater): Compact vacuum-free spin coaters for even thin-film distribution
- [Spin Coating System (Spin Coater + Syringe Pump Bundle)](https://www.ossila.com/products/spin-coater-syringe-pump-bundle): Integrated spin coater and syringe pump system for precise deposition
- [Spin Coater Chucks](https://www.ossila.com/products/spin-coater-chucks): Solvent-safe substrate holder chucks for Ossila spin coaters
- [Spin Coater Foot Switch](https://www.ossila.com/products/spin-coater-foot-switch): Hands-free foot switch accessory for spin coater control

## Slot Die Coating Systems

- [Slot Die Coater](https://www.ossila.com/products/slot-die-coater): Compact slot die coating system for scalable thin-film deposition
- [Slot Die Coating Collection](https://www.ossila.com/collections/slot-die-coating): Slot die coating product collection and system customization
- [Slot Die Heads](https://www.ossila.com/products/slot-die-head): Customizable slot die heads in stainless steel for coating systems
- [Air Knife for Slot Die Coaters](https://www.ossila.com/products/slot-die-coater-air-knife): Adjustable air knife for controlling thin-film drying processes
- [Slot Die Coater Roll Attachment](https://www.ossila.com/products/slot-die-coater-roll-attachment): Roll attachment for slot die coating flexible foil substrates
- [Bar Coating Adapter for Slot Die Coater](https://www.ossila.com/products/bar-coating-adapter-for-slot-die-coater): Quick-mount adapter for Meyer bars on slot die coaters

## Film Applicators & Bar Coaters

- [Automatic Film Applicator](https://www.ossila.com/products/automatic-film-applicator): Versatile automatic film applicator for multiple coating techniques
- [Adjustable Film Applicator](https://www.ossila.com/products/adjustable-film-applicator): Precision adjustable film applicator with manual/digital controls
- [Doctor Blade Coater](https://www.ossila.com/products/doctor-blade-coater): Automated doctor blade coater with vacuum bed for large-area coating
- [Automated Bar Coater](https://www.ossila.com/products/bar-coater): Automated bar coater for simplified thin-film coating processes
- [Mayer Rod](https://www.ossila.com/products/mayer-rod): Stainless steel Mayer rods for accurate thin-film coating
- [Film Applicator Stages](https://www.ossila.com/products/film-applicator-stages): Vacuum and glass stages for mounting samples on applicators
- [Air Knife for Automatic Film Applicator](https://www.ossila.com/products/air-knife-for-automatic-thin-film-applicator): Adjustable air knife for automatic film applicator drying control

## Precision Deposition & Support Equipment

- [Syringe Pumps](https://www.ossila.com/products/syringe-pump): High-precision programmable syringe pump for infusion and extrusion
- [Dip Coater](https://www.ossila.com/products/dip-coater): Precision dip coater with high-precision withdrawal control
- [Diaphragm Vacuum Pump](https://www.ossila.com/products/diaphragm-vacuum-pump): Oil-free diaphragm vacuum pump for substrate holding systems
